dogecoin.text:
Meme coins mooning while your Layer2 dreams crash?  
Little Pepe's building empires, Dogecoin's just a vibe.  
Vitalik's silent, Elon's trolling, and your bags?  
Still dumping. HODL or get rekt, degens.  
Time to pick a side. 🐸

Dogecoin barking loud, TrumpCoin's just a clown show.  
Vitalik's preaching ZK, while pump-and-dump bros glow.  
Web3 dreams big, but memecoins steal the scene.  
HODL or get rekt - crypto's wild, you know what I mean. 🐕💥
